documents.name: Lior Suchard Background
documents.source: Lior Suchard is Israel's most famous mentalist and one of the world's leading mind performers. He has performed for world leaders, celebrities, and audiences across six continents. Lior has appeared on major international TV shows including The Tonight Show with Jay Leno, The Late Show, and numerous European programs. He has performed for US Presidents, A-list Hollywood celebrities, and global business leaders at private events. His act combines apparent mind-reading, telepathy, remote viewing, and behavior influence. Lior wrote the bestselling book 'Mind Reader'. He is known for his sharp wit, charm, and ability to engage both intimate audiences and stadium crowds. He is considered a world-class entertainer who has elevated mentalism to a mainstream performance art. Lior has headlined shows in Las Vegas, London, New York, and Tel Aviv. He holds Guinness World Records related to his performances. His YouTube channel features highlights of his most stunning moments. He is a sought-after corporate entertainer for Fortune 500 companies. Lior represents Israel internationally as a premier entertainment export.
